module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter: a beat counter and shift register collect 8 valid serial bits, then the word is latched to dout_parallel with a dout_valid pulse.

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Serial input bit shifted into the shift register.

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Qualifies each serial bit; enables beat counter and shifting.

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Output register loaded with assembled 8-bit word when counter wraps.

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: Registered pulse accompanying the new parallel word.

anchors.name: beat
anchors.why: Bit position counter from ctr0; MSB gates shifting.

anchors.name: full_k
anchors.why: Counter wrap; loads dout_parallel and drives dout_valid.

anchors.name: acc_bus
anchors.why: Shift register word accumulating serial bits.

anchors.name: low_half
anchors.why: Gates shift enable to the first eight beats.

groups.name: beat_counter
groups.description: Counts valid beats and flags a full byte.

groups.name: shift_register
groups.description: Shifts serial bits into an 8-bit word.

groups.name: output_latch
groups.description: Latches the word and pulses dout_valid on wrap.
